crossRefs.note: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of…

translations.web: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
translations.bsb: He dies for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.
translations.kjv: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
translations.asv: He shall die for lack of instruction; And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
